lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, You are the maker of my heart
The framer and reshaper of my soul

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Master and creator, healer and sustainer
I will put my trust in You alone

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Teach me to be faithful to confess
In this way my spirit will be blessed
Though my sins are daily

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: You have loved me greatly
Removing them as far as East from West

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: Let me be open, let me be humble
Let me find the joy of my salvation in Your cross

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: Let me be broken whenever I stumble
Let me remember the great mercy of my God

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: And give me the full measure of Your grace
As it is reflected in the Word

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Faith and reassurance, mercy and endurance
Carry these to those who haven't heard

lines: Let me be open, let me be humble
Let me find the joy of my salvation in Your cross

lyrics.label: Bridge
lines: All I have needed is laid at Your table
All my achievements, I lay at Your feet

lyrics.label: Bridge
lines: Alive in Your spirit, I'm willing and able
You make my joy complete
